entries.title: Homesteader Origin
entries.summary: A converted origin for remote island farmers, herders, builders, and householders who survive through practical labor.
body: Homesteaders understand the linked work of shelter, water, food, animal care, weather preparation, and maintenance.
Their competence is broad rather than glamorous, and their strongest loyalties often center on a household, plot of land, herd, cistern, or island community.

sections.heading: Converted Hypertext d20 origin package
body: Associated skills: Handle Animal and Survival. These are always class skills for the character.
Origin focus: Gain a +2 origin bonus on Survival checks involving inhabited or cultivable floating islands and on Handle Animal checks involving ordinary domestic or herd animals.
Trade specialty: Choose Craft (carpentry), Profession (farmer), Profession (herder), Profession (brewer), or Profession (fisher).
Starting package: A hand axe or farming tool, a seed pouch or dried herb bundle, a household charm, three days of rations, a waterskin, and 5 gp.

Access feature — Island Survivalist: After one hour surveying a nonbarren island, a successful DC 15 Survival check identifies the most reliable nearby source of water, forage, shelter, or evidence of dangerous flora or fauna. The result identifies one category chosen by the character; exceptionally scarce islands may require a higher DC.

sections.heading: Character creation use
body: Select this origin at 1st level as the character’s single origin package. It does not consume a feat or replace ancestry or class features.
The GM may replace individual pieces of starting gear with setting-equivalent items of roughly equal value.
The origin’s access feature creates a credible route to information, shelter, audiences, or facilities. It does not guarantee cooperation or eliminate payment, law, reputation, or risk.

sourceRefs.notes: Hypertext d20 origin conversion of the source background.
